name: Step 5 Preview
description: Step 5 Preview is StepFun’s flagship AI model for agentic coding, professional knowledge work, and financial analysis. Built on a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 600B total parameters and 27B active per token, it combines a 1M-token context window with vision input. From building interactive applications and debugging code to conducting research and producing analytical reports, it supports complex workflows that require sustained reasoning, tool use, and iterative refinement.
